name: Microsoft Security Copilot
bestFor: AI-assisted threat investigation and response for teams already on Microsoft's security stack
description: An AI assistant for security teams that investigates incidents, summarizes threat intelligence, and drafts response actions across Microsoft Defender, Sentinel, and Entra, billed by compute usage.

freeTier.limits: No free tier; included at no extra cost only for Microsoft 365 E5/E7 tenants (capped SCU allowance)

paidTier.notes: Standalone pricing is $4/hour per provisioned Security Compute Unit (SCU), with pay-as-you-go overage at $6/SCU. Microsoft 365 E5/E7 tenants get 0.4 SCU per license/month (capped at 10,000 SCU/month) included at no extra cost.

name: CrowdStrike Falcon (Charlotte AI)
bestFor: Agentic AI-driven endpoint detection, response, and SOC automation at enterprise scale
description: CrowdStrike's Charlotte AI acts as an agentic security analyst inside the Falcon platform — triaging alerts, investigating incidents, and automating routine SOC workflows for existing Falcon customers.

freeTier.limits: Included for qualifying Falcon customers with 50 AI credits/month; full credits included for enterprise tiers

paidTier.notes: Charlotte AI is bundled into the Falcon platform rather than priced standalone; the underlying Falcon endpoint protection platform is priced per endpoint via a custom quote.

name: Okta
bestFor: Identity and access management with AI-assisted adaptive authentication and lifecycle automation
description: Workforce identity and single sign-on with adaptive, risk-based MFA and automated user lifecycle management — the access-control layer every other enterprise AI tool in this registry ultimately sits behind.

paidTier.notes: Starter $6/user/month (SSO, MFA); Core Essentials $14/user/month (adds adaptive MFA, lifecycle management); Essentials $17/user/month. Professional and Enterprise tiers (governance, API access management) are custom-quoted.
